p: This app is run by the Southwest Bowls Division (“SWD”, “we”), the lawn bowls division covering Southern California. Questions about your privacy: webmaster@swlawnbowls.org.

sections.h: If you use the app without an account
p: We do not ask for or store anything about you. Your saved events, followed clubs, interests, text size and theme stay on your phone only. Like any website, our hosting provider (Vercel) sees your IP address in routine server logs.

We keep your email address. If you choose to add them, we also keep your name, club and phone number. If your email matches the SWD membership roster, we show you your own membership details (club, dues status, novice date). Nobody else sees them in the app.
Your email is used to send you a sign-in code. We do not send marketing or newsletters from the app.
Your profile text, honors, photo (including the photo on your membership card), saved events, followed clubs, interests and profile design are kept on your phone, not on our servers.

Member data is held in a private database run for SWD (Supabase, United States). SWD administrators who maintain the roster can see it. Our service providers that run the database and send sign-in emails process it for us under contract.
Names of players already appear in published tournament results, as they always have. Deleting your account does not remove published results, which are the Division’s record.

The clubs map uses free OpenFreeMap tiles (data from OpenStreetMap). Opening the map sends the area you are viewing, and your IP address as for any web request, to OpenFreeMap. No personal details are sent.

If you use the contact form in the app, the name, email address and message you type are sent to the Southwest Division through a Google Form, and Google processes them as our service provider. We use them only to answer you.

Southwest TV videos are played from YouTube, and tournament draws and entry lists are shown from Google Sheets. When you open them, YouTube or Google receives your IP address and the usual details of a web request, as with any website. We do not send them your name or email.
We do not use advertising or analytics trackers, and we do not sell personal information.
You can edit your profile in the app at any time.

To delete your account and data, email webmaster@swlawnbowls.org from the address you signed in with. We delete the account within 30 days, and deleted data may remain in backups for up to 7 days. In the app, More, then App settings, then Delete my account and data clears everything stored on your phone. For a signed-in account, it also asks us to delete the account, and if that does not complete the app tells you to email us.
California residents may ask to know, correct or delete their personal information using the same contact.
The app is for adults and is not directed at children under 13. We do not ask for ages. If we learn that a child under 13 has an account, we delete it.
We will update this page and its date if anything changes.
These terms cover your use of the Southwest Bowls app, run by the Southwest Bowls Division (“SWD”, “we”). By creating an account you agree to them. You can use the app as a guest without an account.

The app shows tournament dates, entry details, flyers, results, clubs and news for the Southwest Division, and, for members, your own membership details. It is an information service for the lawn bowls community.
Tournament details are provided by tournament organizers and can change. The flyer and the organizer’s instructions are the official source. Please check them before you travel or pay.
Sign in with the email address the Division has on file for you. Keep your sign-in codes private. Tell us if you think someone else has used your account.
You may delete your account at any time in Settings.

sections.h: Being a good member of the community
p: Please use the app respectfully and honestly. Do not try to access other people’s information, disrupt the service, or use it for anything unlawful.
Online tournament entry and payment are not available in the app yet. When they are, the entry fee, refund and withdrawal rules for each tournament will be shown before you pay.
Photos, names and results in the app belong to the Division, its clubs and the people who provided them. Please do not copy them for commercial use.

We work to keep the app accurate and available, but we cannot promise it will always be error-free or uninterrupted. To the extent the law allows, SWD is not liable for losses from relying on information in the app.
We may update these terms and will change the date above when we do. Questions: webmaster@swlawnbowls.org.
